name: Tiling
description: Partition loop nests into smaller rectangular blocks to improve cache locality and reduce memory pressure. Each tile fits intermediate results within L1/L2 cache, enabling more efficient reuse and computation.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each loop dimension. Position 0 tiles the outermost loop, position 1 the next, etc. A value of 0 means 'do not tile this loop'. At least one non-zero value must be present.
